title: Expansion Manifest (draft)
description: DRAFT, RESEARCH ONLY. A hypothetical description of an expansion arrangement for an ignited reaction. No destination network is named, selected, or implied: destinations are referenced by opaque identifier only. Nothing described here is implemented, and no expansion mechanism exists. Field names and value domains are under research and are not final.

schema_version.description: Draft revision. Not a released version number.

source.description: The originating reaction on Arc. Always the authoritative origin in this draft.

chain.description: Origin chain. Fixed to Arc: expansion originates from an Arc reaction by definition.

ignited.description: Must be true. Expansion is considered strictly post-ignition in this research direction.

migrated_position_reference.description: Reference to the permanent Uniswap V4 position on Arc. Present for context; this position is never a source of funds for expansion.

eligibility.description: How this reaction became eligible to expand. All four framings are unresolved; see docs/expansion-lifecycle.md.

status.description: Every eligibility framing in this repository is unresolved. Other values are reserved and not in use.

declared_at_spark.description: Whether eligibility was fixed before the reaction's first trade. Null where the framing does not define this.

representation.description: How the asset is represented in the additional ecosystem.

destination_ref.description: OPAQUE IDENTIFIER ONLY. Deliberately not a chain name, chain id, or anything resolvable to a specific network. No destination is named in this repository.

model.description: Representation model under consideration. No model is recommended; see research/trust-models.md.

canonical_origin.description: Which side is authoritative. 'arc' is the only value consistent with the current draft; others are recorded to make the alternatives explicit, not to endorse them.

supply_invariant.description: How, if at all, a global supply invariant is maintained, and by what means it is guaranteed.

guaranteed_by.description: Critical distinction. 'construction' means arithmetic truth; 'mechanism' means the invariant holds only while a mechanism behaves correctly. These must never be presented as equivalent.

additional_liquidity.description: Liquidity at the destination. Always additional and separately funded: Arc migrated liquidity cannot be relocated.

separately_funded.description: Must be true. A value of false would imply relocating permanent Arc liquidity, which has no mechanism.

fee_accounting.description: Whether and how the 30/70 distribution applies at the destination. Entirely unresolved.

trust_assumptions.description: Every assumption the native Arc lifecycle does not require. Must be non-empty: every expansion model introduces at least one. An empty array would be a claim that expansion is trustless, which no model supports.

reversibility.description: Whether holders at the destination have a path back to Arc. Unresolved; see docs/expansion-lifecycle.md.
